rubric: Two grades per tool. The in-scope grade weighs entity-level F1, precision discipline (specificity on decoys and raw false positives) and agent-tier discrimination on the surfaces the tool ran. The program grade weighs the same qualities by estate recall (coverage of all expected entities across nine surfaces) and reliability (errors, self-declared incompleteness). Grades are the benchmark author's judgement over the measured numbers, not a formula; the numbers are in metrics.json.
caveat: The rubrics, corpus and adapters are author-written in ShadowScan's own repository and are not independent review. Eight surfaces are synthetic. Per-surface samples are small and the intervals are wide. Four listed tools could not be exercised offline.

shadowscan.rationale: The only tool on all nine surfaces, zero crashes; strong on gateway, code, network, low-code and endpoint. Loses the A on precision: identity specificity 57% and SaaS specificity 33%, because it inventories admin-scoped service identities and non-AI workspace bots as findings and calls classic topic-only Copilot Studio bots agents. Twenty live-runtime scans were self-declared incomplete. The asterisk is the conflict of interest: the maintainer wrote the rubrics.

ai-infra-guard.rationale: Perfect precision and 100% specificity across the decoy services with 81% recall (it missed Flowise). Its AI-Agent-Config fingerprint fires on any JSON 404 body, so vLLM, TGI and LiteLLM were labelled agent configuration. One surface only.

fleet-ai-tools.rationale: Best endpoint recall of the endpoint-only tools with two false positives, and clean MCP detection on live processes. It does not recognise coding-agent CLIs or model servers from command lines alone; its fleet-scale strength cannot show on a single host.

snyk-agent-scan.rationale: No false positives and 39% agent recall. It looks only for MCP configurations and skills, so it never sees Ollama, Aider, Continue, Goose or Cline.

agentmesh-discovery.rationale: High precision but 8% recall: a short list of configuration filenames, and process regexes that miss the common @modelcontextprotocol paths. Public preview behaviour.

vet.rationale: Code precision 100% at 8% recall, but it reported plain VS Code as a coding agent on every home with a .vscode directory: 39 false positives in 40 homes.

numbat.rationale: Found 3 of 24 endpoint artifacts with no false positives. Its real strength, forensic session reconstruction, is not measured here.

agentdiscover.rationale: 247 false-positive facts on 26 repositories and 1 of 24 endpoint artifacts found; its configuration paths are macOS-shaped.

cisco-mcp-scanner.rationale: 1 of 24 artifacts at 4.4 seconds per home; its Linux path table covers three clients. It is an MCP auditor rather than a discovery tool.

not_graded.Cartography: needs Neo4j and live cloud APIs
not_graded.Microsoft Copilot Studio Kit (Agent Inve: a Power Platform solution; no offline entry point
not_graded.Google k8s-aibom: an in-cluster controller with no manifest mode
not_graded.AgentSight: eBPF uprobes on live TLS libraries
